description: UC Berkeley — strong CA in-state applicant, RD, CS major
rationale: UCB uses a Tier 1 CS-aware anchor; strong CA in-state stats push to the upper end. The 2026-05-31 48-flagship audit corrected the CA in-state multiplier 1.2→1.35 (UC Information Center: CA resident 14.9% / overall 11%), so a strong-profile band anchor (~0.25) × 1.35 ≈ 0.34. Range [0.2, 0.38] allows the data-grounded ~34% while keeping the guardrail that UCB CS remains highly competitive.
